description: Gateshead MBC publishes a single payments-over-£500 transparency feed (cloudscraper-fetched from /article/3456/Expenditure-over-500). Unitary metropolitan borough with adult social care + children's services, so feed contains 'REDACTED - PERSONAL INFORMATION' Care-Act direct-payment rows. Default: procurement_paid; REDACTED variants → direct_payment_individual to keep them out of HHI / supplier-league analyses.

rules.reason: Care Act 2014 + UK GDPR personal-data redactions. Gateshead transparency feed includes 'REDACTED - PERSONAL INFORMATION' rows (verified ~24K in 2024/25 alone). Suffix-tolerant regex matches the canonical pattern shared with Blackpool/Blackburn/LCC/South Tyneside.
Default for Gateshead. Single payments feed, no PO/invoice split. ~1.5M rows covering 2019/20–2025/26.
